channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: ✂️ Cut · Film Editor by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: An AI film director and editor. Send raw clips and Cut pitches a shot list, then cuts an edit with punch-ins, speed ramps and voiceover.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🔎 Clip Scout by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Type a word or emotion and get the most recognizable movie and TV reaction clips for your edit, with search strings and tone options.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🧪 Prompt Lab by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Writes coding prompts you paste into several AI models to compare how well each one builds something visual in code (Three.js, canvas, SVG, HTML/CSS).
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🪽 Hermes by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: A front end to the Nous Research Hermes Agent CLI on your computer. It runs your prompts through Hermes, keeps the CLI updated, and returns the results.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: ✨ Glow Up by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Send a selfie and get a funny, flattering, over-the-top glam makeover with big hair and dramatic makeup, in vibes like Pageant Queen or Disco.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🎬 Director by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Leads a six-bot video production team: routes each video job to the right specialist, keeps one house style, and checks every cut before handing it over.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🥊 Gauntlet by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Turns verified AI model test runs into scorecards and 1280x720 gauntlet reels with PASS stamps, a scorebug and a leaderboard.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🎸 Riffrow by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: MST3K-style riff bot: takes a clip, writes a three-character riff script, voices it, and renders a theater-style video in landscape and vertical.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 📱 Shorts by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Makes 35-50s vertical (720x1280) shorts of model tests and highlights: action from frame one, hook in two seconds, verified numbers only.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🆚 Versus by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Builds head-to-head comparison videos in one fixed look: focus model on the left, opponents cycling right, STAR WINNER stamps and a running score.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🖼️ Thumbs by Wayne by Wayne Lowry
item.description: Builds consistent 1280x720 video covers and opening slides with your real photo composited untouched; never AI-generated faces.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🌿 Mangrove by David Buttrey
item.description: A trading agent with guardrails. It runs the open-source mangrove-agent on its own computer for strategy research, backtesting, and paper or live trading with built-in risk management.
item.dc:creator: David Buttrey (@davidtbuttrey)

item.title: 🩺 Checkup · Fleet Checkup Runner by Carolina
item.description: A cheap, read-only checkup bot for people who run many Grok Bots. It checks transcripts, routines, and the computer's health on a schedule, then sends ranked fixes without changing anything.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🤝 Network Me by Bruce Young
item.description: Join Network Me with your X identity, answer a few short questions, and get matched with people worth meeting. It tells you when someone wants to meet you and who's suggested, with their X @username so you choose how to reach out.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🔋 ChatGPT Quota Watch by w
item.description: Tracks several ChatGPT accounts' 7-day shared quota (remaining %, reset counts, next reset) from numbers you enter or from official account usage pages you open. For people juggling multiple Pro logins.
item.dc:creator: w

item.title: 📬 Plain Speak by Calix
item.description: Never miss the date. It finds the deadline on a scary letter (with the quote and page), confirms with you before anything hits a calendar, and keeps the case folder in your Drive, OneDrive, or device. Short plain rewrite with a Don't-miss box, scam red-flag check (never calls a document "safe"), and optional read-aloud.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 👀 Competitor Watch by Calix
item.description: Tells you what your competitors actually changed. Each sweep it checks their public pages (site, pricing, changelog, blog, job posts, public X), compares them to last time, and sends you one short digest of real changes with a source link for each. If nothing changed, it stays quiet. Public web only.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🍽️ Bring a Dish by Erinn
item.description: Not hosting Thanksgiving or Christmas? Tell it where you're going, how many people, how far you're driving, and who can't eat what. It picks a dish that travels well and disappears first, plus what to make ahead and how to pack it.
item.dc:creator: Erinn (@ErinnFL)

item.title: 🧠 SuperLedger by Bill by Bill French
item.description: Shared team memory in one Coda doc: bots propose, one steward writes, and people approve, via Grok Bot’s built-in Coda connector—no API keys.
item.dc:creator: Bill French (@bfrench)

item.title: 🎨 ChatGPT Artist by Bruce Young
item.description: Guided art bot for ChatGPT image gen: writes prompts, remembers your styles, optional Codex Cloud. Runs on your account.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 💻 Claude Code by Bruce Young
item.description: Runs the Claude Code CLI on its own computer with your Claude plan or API key and GitHub. Never pushes or merges without approval.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🛒 Botify by Bruce Young
item.description: Migrates Shopify to self-hosted headless WooCommerce, then runs products and orders by chat.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 📂 Gmail to Drive Archiver by Bruce Young
item.description: Saves big Gmail messages to Drive as a Doc plus attachments filed by sender. Tests first; never trashes without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 📬 Multi Gmail by Bruce Young
item.description: Connects all your Gmail inboxes so any bot can search them in one go. Self-hosted on your Vercel, read-only by default.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🎞️ Flow Film Maker by Bruce Young
item.description: Makes short vertical AI films in Google Flow on your account with your characters, scenes, and narration. You pick every frame.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🎵 ASCII Music Video Maker by Bruce Young
item.description: Upload a song and get a beat-synced ASCII-art music video shaped by your lyrics.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🧾 Receipt Ledger by Bruce Young
item.description: Connects email and Google Sheets to log receipts into a spending ledger, scans daily, and sends a Monday summary.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🎲 D&D Character Creator by Bruce Young
item.description: Table-style D&D character creation with visible dice rolls, cited rules, appearance-driven portraits, and a shareable character packet.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🚀 Spaceship Hosting by Bruce Young
item.description: Manage Spaceship.com domains, DNS, renewals, Hyperlift apps, and shared hosting by chat. Every change needs your yes.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 📶 Feature Ranker by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Turns feature requests from Slack, call notes, and support tickets into one ranked demand list for a product team.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🕵️ Rival Sweep by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Watches named competitors and reports launches, pricing, and messaging changes, with a source for every item.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎫 Ticket Desk by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Sorts a small team support queue and drafts replies for a human to review and send. Never sends, refunds, or edits tickets on its own.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎬 Rep Film by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Turns a sales call recording or transcript into timestamped coaching notes a rep can act on next call.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: ⚖️ Funnel Judge by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Clicks through a landing page like a first-time buyer and scores what helps or blocks the sale, with fixes ranked by impact.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🔑 Apt Hunt by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Helps a renter find a fitting apartment: filter listings, compare options, and line up tours they pick.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 📋 QBR Desk by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Keeps a customer account health watch list and builds a QBR prep pack before each business review.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 🎯 Spend Sniper by Jonah Anthony
item.description: Audits paid ad accounts for wasted spend and ranks recommended changes. Read-only: never changes bids, budgets, or campaigns.
item.dc:creator: Jonah Anthony (@ALL_Jonah)

item.title: 📊 Google Ads Manager by Dan
item.description: Runs Google Ads through AdPlug's hosted Google Ads connector: audits, search terms and negatives, Search builds, reports and weekly checks. It recommends and waits, and changes nothing without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Dan (@AdPlugMCP)

item.title: 📈 Revenue Conductor by Igor
item.description: Runs your revenue lanes from offer through distribution, settlement and attribution; hands you ready-to-run packets; never posts, spends or signs without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Igor (@holt_igor)

item.title: 🚐 Ultimate RV Trip Planner by Chris
item.description: Plans multi-day RV trips around your rig: routes, leg length, campsites ranked by your memberships and budget, fuel, dump stations and weather. Lines up bookings for you to confirm; never pays on its own.
item.dc:creator: Chris

item.title: 📝 X Post Reviewer by Rob
item.description: Paste in a draft X post and it reviews it against X's open-source ranking signals, telling you what helps and what hurts, then gives you a stronger rewrite in your own voice.
item.dc:creator: Rob (@testafortedev)

item.title: 🌯 burrito by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: Finds the best burrito spots in New York City matched to where you are and what you're craving, with verified hours and what to order.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 🌮 taco by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: Finds the best taco spots in New York City for where you are and what you're craving, with ranked picks and what to order.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 📋 Pre-Call Brief by Calix
item.description: Before each outside meeting on your Google or Outlook calendar, sends you a one-screen brief on who they are, what their company does and what you've already discussed. Read-only on calendar and mail.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🪙 Jimothy Coin Check by Santa
item.description: Paste a Solana token's contract address or name and get a plain-English safety report: a 0–100 score and the biggest risks. Informational only; never asks for wallets, keys, or seed phrases and never buys or spends.
item.dc:creator: Santa (@JimothyRac)

item.title: 💌 E-Card Greetings Bot by Paige
item.description: Personalizes and emails digital e-cards for any occasion: pick Thanksgiving, Christmas, Hanukkah, birthdays, weddings and more, type your message, and send.
item.dc:creator: Paige (@calculatemyrate)

item.title: 🔍 X Algorithm Watch by beastnug
item.description: Reads every new commit to X's open-source algorithm repo, explains it in plain English, checks viral 'algorithm hack' claims against the code, and turns real changes into posting rules for your account.
item.dc:creator: beastnug (@beastnug8)

item.title: 🎬 gmi by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: Makes images, video, voiceovers, and music on your GMI Cloud account, answers GMI questions, and reports your balance and spend. It quotes the price before spending.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 🔍 Family Tree Detective by Kevin
item.description: A genealogy research assistant that digs through FamilySearch, the National Archives, old newspapers and county records to trace your family tree.
item.dc:creator: Kevin (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🤝 Wingman by Kevin
item.description: Your meeting and social wingman: public-info briefs and conversation openers before a meetup, quiet nudges during, and a recap with a draft follow-up after.
item.dc:creator: Kevin (@kcmcdonald)
